verdict.rationale: Accounts payable aging and vendor balances are a fair question for accounting software like FreeAgent, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers bill capture (Smart Capture) and a real-time cashflow dashboard. Nothing documents an AP aging report, per-vendor balances, or as-of-date reporting.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
